description: Replace reachable first-root Pipeline and dm-review cache lookups with coherent host-aware Workflow Kernel resolution and mutation-sensitive regression coverage.

decisionProfile.rationale: The reachable consumers and correct existing resolver are proven, the change is bounded to workflow instructions and validation, and no production data or authorization surface changes.

finalReviewRationale: The user explicitly requires quick/focused verification, no full dm-review, and native Codex inspection of every changed line; consequence is low and no rendered or sensitive product surface is involved.

chunks.title: Host-aware cache resolution
chunks.renderedSurfaceRationale: All listed changes are Markdown workflow instructions, shell validation, JSON plugin metadata, and Python test fixtures, with no served route, rendered product output, UI interaction, or browser criterion.
